cases.name: file-without-src
cases.description: A file generator with no file
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="file"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: row-without-column
cases.description: A row link needs a column to link on
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="file" src="x.csv" row="k"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: row-without-src-or-column
cases.description: A missing src does not hide the second thing that is wrong
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="file" row="k"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: drawing-source-missing
cases.description: A drawing that is not there is caught before the run, not on row one
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="pattern" src="nowhere.svg" y_range="0..9"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: dotted-ref-unknown-field
cases.description: A typo AFTER the dot is caught, not only before it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="q"/><data>-</data><data name="k">K</data></sequence><mix name="M" percent="50,50"><case><gen type="text" value="m"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="n"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{P.gone}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: dotted-ref-valid-field
cases.description: A real field, and a constant one, resolve — no diagnostic at all. The half of the dotted check that must never fire.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="q"/><data>-</data><data name="k">K</data></sequence><mix name="M" percent="50,50"><case><gen type="text" value="m"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="n"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{P.a}}${{C.k}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: dotted-ref-on-a-fieldless-name
cases.description: A <mix> has no fields at all, so any dot on it is wrong
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="q"/><data>-</data><data name="k">K</data></sequence><mix name="M" percent="50,50"><case><gen type="text" value="m"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="n"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{M.gone}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: dotted-ref-second-level
cases.description: There is no second level below a field
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="q"/><data>-</data><data name="k">K</data></sequence><mix name="M" percent="50,50"><case><gen type="text" value="m"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="n"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{P.a.deeper}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: parent-on-a-compound
cases.description: A compound produces no value, so nothing can be filtered on it — caught before the run
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="q"/><data>-</data><data name="k">K</data></sequence><mix name="M" percent="50,50"><case><gen type="text" value="m"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="n"/></case></mix><sequence name="Kid" parent="P.a"><gen type="text" value="z"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-on-an-unknown-field
cases.description: A switch subject with a good sequence and a bad field
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="q"/><data>-</data><data name="k">K</data></sequence><mix name="M" percent="50,50"><case><gen type="text" value="m"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="n"/></case></mix><switch name="S" on="P.gone"><map>x:1</map></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-on-a-gen-is-checked-at-all
cases.description: A conditional gen's own if= is an expression like any other — only the reference was checking it. "%" parses everywhere and is supported nowhere.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="Z"><gen if="1 & 2" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-name-alone-undeclared
cases.description: A bare word as the whole condition reads as its own text, so the branch fires on every row
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="Nope" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-name-undeclared-compared
cases.description: The same word on the LEFT of a comparison equals nothing, so the branch fires on no row
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="Nope == 'x'" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-bare-word-on-the-right
cases.description: The documented idiom: a word on the right of a comparison is a literal, not a name, and must never be flagged
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="G == Male" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-value-sugar-is-not-a-field
cases.description: Gender.Male asks whether G came out Male — the tail is a value, which the config cannot be asked about
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="G.Male" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-field-undeclared-on-a-compound
cases.description: Where the root IS a compound the tail is a field, and a field either exists or is a typo
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="P"><gen name="a" type="text" value="x"/><gen name="b" type="text" value="y"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="P.gone == 'x'" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-value-not-in-a-visible-list
cases.description: A typo in the VALUE after the dot. A warning, not an error: the config runs, the branch is simply dead — and a list narrowed on purpose is a real thing people write
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="G.Mail" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-value-in-a-visible-list
cases.description: The same shape spelled right — the half that must never fire
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="G.Male" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: if-value-where-a-transform-rewrites-it
cases.description: case= rewrites what the sequence produces, so the written list is no longer what is compared and nothing can be claimed about it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="Male,Female" percent="50,50" case="upper"/></sequence><sequence name="Z"><gen if="G.Male" type="text" value="a"/><gen type="text" value="b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Z}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="a,b" percent="50,30,20"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><mix name="M" percent="50,30,20"><case><data>a</data></case><case><data>b</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="increment" value="one"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="a,b" case="shouty"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: unknown-order

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="a,b" order="backwards"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: malformed-map-row

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="S"><gen type="text" value="RU,US"/></sequence><switch name="W" on="S"><map>RU:Russia, oops</map></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: type-without-a-name
cases.description: A declared type on a piece that is not a column
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data type="int64">${{G}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: unparsable-column-type
cases.description: A column type that is not one
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence></env><block><line><data name="g" type="int65">${{G}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-format-unterminated-literal
cases.description: A bracket literal nobody closed
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" value="today" format="YYYY [at"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-unknown-precision
cases.description: A precision the generator does not implement
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" value="today" precision="fortnight"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: birth-ages-inverted
cases.description: youngest older than oldest, which spans nothing
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="date" value="birth" oldest="20" youngest="50"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-range-without-range
cases.description: date.range with nothing to range over
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="template" value="date.range"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: date-range-malformed
cases.description: A range that is not two dotted dates
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="template" value="date.range" range="1990-01-01..2000-12-31"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-bad-parameters
cases.description: A distribution whose parameters do not describe a shape
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="number" distribution="normal" mean="10" sd="-1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: named-column-in-an-each-line
cases.description: A typed column on a line that emits several rows per record
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="T"><gen type="number" value="1..9" repeat="2"/></sequence></env><block><line each="T"><data name="t">${{T}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: template-path-missing-for-the-locale
cases.description: A path the en pack ships and ru does not: check used to pass and the run then refused it with "unknown template path", which reads as a typo and is not one
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="ru"><sequence name="S"><gen type="template" value="clothing.shoeSizeUs"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-drawing-with-nothing-to-draw
cases.description: A pattern reads a shape from points=, from a file in src=, or from upper=/lower=. With none of the three it has nothing to read, and the run stopped on row one where TDC095 and TDC128 stop before it for the two regex types.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="X"><gen type="pattern"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: percent-beside-order-sequential-is-refused
cases.description: order="sequential" gives row r element `r mod N` — a rule about POSITION, which leaves no room for a rule about SHARE. The engine's own comment says it ignores the percent, and nothing told the user: percent="98,1,1" over a hundred rows came out 34/33/33 from a config `check` had called valid. The same list-walking applies to type="file", which dropped the shares the same way.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="100" seed="s"><sequence name="S"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c" percent="98,1,1" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{S}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mask-on-a-running-total-is-refused-not-ignored
cases.description: running resolves before the formatting layer, so mask= sat there doing nothing; the filter at the print site is the working route
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="running" of="N" accumulate="sum" mask="x"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{X}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-on-a-stat-is-refused-not-ignored
cases.description: stat publishes one number for the whole run and never goes through the formatting layer
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="stat" of="N" op="sum" missing="0.5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{X}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: the-same-wrappers-still-work-on-a-number
cases.description: the refusal is per type: a number puts its value through the whole formatting layer
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="s"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="10..99" mask="x" missing="0.5" anomaly="0.5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{X}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: http-secret-written-into-the-config
cases.description: A key written into a config travels wherever the config does, version control included. A WARNING rather than an error: a service on 127.0.0.1 for an afternoon is a real use, and refusing it would only teach people to put the key somewhere worse.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="M"><gen type="http" src="http://127.0.0.1:5599/gen" secret="1234567890"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: http-secret-with-no-key
cases.description: The other half of the same code, and an error rather than a warning: signing with nothing produces a signature every caller could forge, which is worse than sending the request unsigned.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="M"><gen type="http" src="http://127.0.0.1:5599/gen" secret=""/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-drawing-mode-that-is-not-a-mode
cases.description: mode= was read only by the generator, so `check` called this valid and the run then refused it with a bare sentence and no code — the one place `check` did not answer "would this run?".
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" y_range="0..10" points="0,0 1,5" mode="banana"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-drawing-interpolation-that-is-not-one
cases.description: The same hole in the attribute beside it.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" y_range="0..10" points="0,0 1,5" interp="banana"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-negative-drawing-spread
cases.description: A number rather than a word, held to the same rule: half a band cannot be negative.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" y_range="0..10" points="0,0 1,5" spread="-1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: drawing-decimals-that-are-not-a-number
cases.description: The fourth and last of the drawing attributes whose value the generator alone used to read.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" y_range="0..10" points="0,0 1,5" decimals="x"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-drawing-mode-that-is-a-mode
cases.description: The other half of the rule: the two words the generator accepts stay accepted.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" y_range="0..10" points="0,0 1,5" mode="density"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-drawing-with-no-width
cases.description: Two points on ONE x. There is no width, so "where this card's line crosses the drawing" has no single answer — the same emptiness as a single point, one step later. The engine used to take the first point and say nothing, which is the silent half of a refusal that already exists for one point.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="50,10 50,90" y_range="0..100"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-semicolon-in-points-is-not-two-lines
cases.description: A `;` looks like it separates two curves and does not: every number in the string is read in order, so this silently becomes ONE curve of four points. Somebody writing it meant a band and got a shape they never drew. The refusal names the spelling that works — upper= and lower= — because the mistake is a guess at syntax, not a typo.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,20 100,20; 0,80 100,80" y_range="0..100"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-fit-band-written-largest-first
cases.description: fit= names what the drawing's lowest and highest point become, so the low bound cannot be the larger number. Swapping them silently would hide the typo, and reading it as "flip the drawing" would be a second feature nobody asked for.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="X"><gen type="pattern" src="nope.svg" y_range="0..100" fit="297..255"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-fit-band-spelled-with-a-comma
cases.description: A comma is a LIST everywhere else in the language (percent="60,40", value="a,b"), and a range is always A..B. Accepting the comma here would make one punctuation mark mean two things.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="X"><gen type="pattern" src="nope.svg" y_range="0..100" fit="255,297"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: fit-beside-points-that-already-carry-a-board
cases.description: A typed point is a percentage of the 0..100 board, so 90 already means 90% of y_range. fit= places a drawing that arrived WITHOUT a board, from src=. Written together the two contradict each other, and picking one silently is how a config comes to say something it does not do.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="X"><gen type="pattern" points="0,10 100,90" y_range="0..100" fit="255..297"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-csv-column-that-is-not-in-the-header
cases.description: The file has a header row and no column called "phone". Caught by loading the file at check time, which is the only way to know — and cheap next to discovering it a million rows into a run. Two doc pages quote this message; until now nothing verified it against the engine.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="V"><gen type="file" src="people.csv" column="phone"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
